title: The Latest Crier for Nov 02, 2026
items:
Looking to play intramurals but don't have a team?

No problem! If you're interested in participating, fill out the spreadsheet linked below with your name, email, and the sport(s) you'd like to play. We'll use the information submitted to help connect free agents and form teams whenever possible. Don't miss your chance to get involved, meet new people, and participate in intramurals this semester! 
Interest Sign-Up: Intramural interest list.xlsx

Fall Intramural Sign-Ups

Fall Intramural sign-ups are open! Make sure to get your teams together and sign up for those! Follow along on our Instagram (@CentralCollegeIM) for updates on when sign-ups open/close! Use our Linktree to take you to our hub for sign-ups: https://linktr.ee/centralcollegeim
